name: docker-lab-40-disaster-recovery
description: Disaster recovery (Node): region A dies under traffic — backup & restore vs pilot light vs warm standby vs active-active, measuring RTO (time to serve again), RPO (acknowledged orders lost) and what runs idle in region B; plus slow-motion tools (lib/replicator.js, lib/failover.js), sync vs async replication, DNS TTL model and why a replica is not a backup
